traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת הַ בָּקָ֥ר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֖ר תַּחְתָּֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς μόσχους τοὺς δώδεκα ὑποκάτω αὐτῆς ,
traditions.VUL: boves quoque duódecim sub mari ,
traditions.KJV: and twelve oxen under it .

16.english_reference: The pots also , and the shovels , and the fleshhooks , and all their instruments ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת הַ֠ סִּירוֹת וְ אֶת הַ יָּעִ֤ים וְ אֶת הַ מִּזְלָגוֹת֙ וְ אֶת כָּל כְּלֵי הֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοὺς ποδιστῆρας καὶ τοὺς ἀναλημπτῆρας καὶ τοὺς λέβητας καὶ τὰς κρεάγρας , καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῶν
traditions.VUL: et lebétes , et créagras , et phíalas . Omnia vasa
traditions.KJV: The pots also , and the shovels , and the fleshhooks , and all their instruments ,

16.english_reference: did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass .

traditions.WLC: עָשָׂ֞ה חוּרָ֥ם אָבִ֛יו לַ מֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְ בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה נְחֹ֖שֶׁת מָרֽוּק
traditions.LXX: ἃ ἐποίησεν Χειρὰμ καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν τῷ βασιλεῖ Σαλωμὼν ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου χαλκοῦ καθαροῦ .
traditions.VUL: fecit Salomóni Hiram pater eius in domo Dómini ex ære mundíssimo .
traditions.KJV: did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass .

17.english_reference: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them ,

traditions.WLC: בְּ כִכַּ֤ר הַ יַּרְדֵּן֙ יְצָקָ֣ ם הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ περιχώρῳ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου ἐχώνευσεν αὐτὰ ὁ βασιλεὺς
traditions.VUL: In regióne Iordánis fudit ea rex
traditions.KJV: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them ,

17.english_reference: in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah .

traditions.WLC: בַּ עֲבִ֖י הָ אֲדָמָ֑ה בֵּ֥ין סֻכּ֖וֹת וּ בֵ֥ין צְרֵדָֽתָ ה
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ πάχει τῆς γῆς , ἐν οἴκῳ Σεχχὼθ καὶ Ἀναμεσιρδάθαι .
traditions.VUL: in argillósa terra inter Sochot et Sarédatha .
traditions.KJV: in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah .

18.english_reference: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance :

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֧עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה כָּל הַ כֵּלִ֥ים הָ אֵ֖לֶּה לָ רֹ֣ב מְאֹ֑ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν Σαλωμὼν πάντα τὰ σκεύη ταῦτα εἰς πλῆθος σφόδρα ,
traditions.VUL: Erat autem multitúdo vasórum innumerábilis ,
traditions.KJV: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance :

18.english_reference: for the weight of the brass could not be found out .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֛י לֹ֥א נֶחְקַ֖ר מִשְׁקַ֥ל הַ נְּחֹֽשֶׁת
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ ἐξέλιπεν ὁλκὴ τοῦ χαλκοῦ .
traditions.VUL: ita ut ignorarétur pondus æris .
traditions.KJV: for the weight of the brass could not be found out .

19.english_reference: And Solomon made all the vessels that [ were for ] the house of God ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל הַ כֵּלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּ֣ית הָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν Σαλωμὼν πάντα τὰ σκεύη οἴκου Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: Fecítque Sálomon ómnia vasa domus Dei ,
traditions.KJV: And Solomon made all the vessels that [ were for ] the house of God ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַ זָּהָ֔ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τὸ χρυσοῦν
traditions.VUL: et altáre áureum ,
traditions.KJV: the golden altar also ,

19.english_reference: and the tables whereon the shewbread [ was set ] ;

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת הַ שֻּׁלְחָנ֔וֹת וַ עֲלֵי הֶ֖ם לֶ֥חֶם הַ פָּנִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰς τραπέζας , καὶ ἐπ᾽ αὐτῶν ἄρτοι προθέσεως ,
traditions.VUL: et mensas , et super eas panes propositiónis :
traditions.KJV: and the tables whereon the shewbread [ was set ] ;

20.english_reference: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת הַ מְּנֹר֞וֹת וְ נֵרֹתֵי הֶ֗ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰς λυχνίας καὶ τοὺς λύχνους
traditions.VUL: candelábra quoque cum lucérnis suis ,
traditions.KJV: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps ,

20.english_reference: that they should burn after the manner before the oracle , of pure gold ;

traditions.WLC: לְ בַעֲרָ֧ ם כַּ מִּשְׁפָּ֛ט לִ פְנֵ֥י הַ דְּבִ֖יר זָהָ֥ב סָגֽוּר
traditions.LXX: τοῦ φωτὸς κατὰ τὸ κρίμα καὶ κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ δαβεὶρ χρυσίου καθαροῦ ,
traditions.VUL: ut lucérent ante oráculum iuxta ritum ex auro puríssimo :
traditions.KJV: that they should burn after the manner before the oracle , of pure gold ;

21.english_reference: And the flowers , and the lamps , and the tongs ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ פֶּ֧רַח וְ הַ נֵּר֛וֹת וְ הַ מֶּלְקַחַ֖יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ λαβίδες αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ λύχνοι αὐτῶν , καὶ τὰς φιάλας καὶ τὰς θυὶσκας καὶ τὰ πυρεῖα
traditions.VUL: et floréntia quædam , et lucérnas , et fórcipes
traditions.KJV: And the flowers , and the lamps , and the tongs , [ made he of ]

21.english_reference: [ made he of ] gold , [ and ] that perfect gold ;

traditions.WLC: זָהָ֑ב ה֖וּא מִכְל֥וֹת זָהָֽב
traditions.LXX: χρυσίου καθαροῦ ,
traditions.VUL: áureos : ómnia de auro mundíssimo facta sunt .
traditions.KJV: gold , [ and ] that perfect gold ;

22.english_reference: And the snuffers , and the basons , and the spoons , and the censers , [ of ] pure gold :

traditions.WLC: וְ הַֽ מְזַמְּר֧וֹת וְ הַ מִּזְרָק֛וֹת וְ הַ כַּפּ֥וֹת וְ הַ מַּחְתּ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר
traditions.VUL: Thymiatéria quoque , et thuríbula , et phíalas , et mortaríola ex auro puríssimo .
traditions.KJV: And the snuffers , and the basons , and the spoons , and the censers , [ of ] pure gold :

22.english_reference: and the entry of the house , the inner doors thereof for the most holy [ place ] ,

traditions.WLC: וּ פֶ֣תַח הַ֠ בַּיִת דַּלְתוֹתָ֨י ו הַ פְּנִימִיּ֜וֹת לְ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ קֳּדָשִׁ֗ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ θύρα τοῦ οἴκου ἡ ἐσωτέρα εἰς τὰ ἅγια τῶν ἁγίων ,
traditions.VUL: Et óstia cælávit templi interióris , id est , in Sancta sanctórum :
traditions.KJV: and the entry of the house , the inner doors thereof for the most holy [ place ] ,

22.english_reference: and the doors of the house of the temple , [ were of ] gold .

traditions.WLC: וְ דַלְתֵ֥י הַ בַּ֛יִת לַ הֵיכָ֖ל זָהָֽב
traditions.LXX: εἰς τὰς θύρας τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ ναοῦ χρυσᾶς .
traditions.VUL: et óstia templi forínsecus áurea .
traditions.KJV: and the doors of the house of the temple , [ were of ] gold .

traditions.LXX: καὶ συνετελέσθη πᾶσα ἡ ἐργασία ἣν ἐποίησεν Σαλωμὼν ἐν οἴκῳ Κυρίου .
